build_asdiv_dataset: run the build function to download and set up the ASDIV dataset into the data directory
review_build_function: review the build function that checks version, creates directories, and downloads ASDIV data files
refactor_build_function: refactor the build function to support additional downloadable resources or a different dataset URL
summarize_build_function: summarize the build function logic for downloading and versioning the ASDIV dataset
test_build_function: test the build function to verify it downloads ASDIV.xml and marks the data directory as built
